name: output-page-401
description: The pages endpoint is authenticated by the login cookie, like every other call but login (C1 decision 3; 5.48; F15): without one, GET /sessions/{id}/output is 401 unauthenticated and no page is served. Published e2 so the web lane may build against it; required green at e5, where a core ring first exists (no core ring at E2, and an E2 core that does not serve pages answers 501 not_implemented).
